_note: Signals that decide what the briefing leads with. kind 'change' = something new this hour; kind 'condition' = the standing situation. A change scoring at least lead_threshold leads the briefing; otherwise it leads with the top condition. Score = weight x strength (graded signals 1-2). Tests live in digest.py (signals).

outlook_new.why: NEA just published; people look for it, so it should lead unless something bigger happened

outlook_changed.why: NEA's forecast category moved since the previous snapshot

pm25_jump.why: 1-hr PM2.5 moved sharply within 3 h in a region

pm25_band_change.why: a region crossed an NEA 1-hr PM2.5 band within 3 h

psi_band_change.why: a region's 24-hr PSI crossed a band within 6 h

advice_change.why: the app's advisory level changed within 3 h in a region

regional_spread.why: regions differ enough that place matters

haze_over_sg.why: a satellite haze outline covers Singapore

dense_haze_near.why: a dense haze outline is close

fires_anomaly.why: regional fire detections far above the 2019-2024 norm

wind_from_fires.why: modelled wind at a large fire area points toward Singapore most of the next 24 h

rain_now.why: showers in the current 2-hour forecast can briefly clean the air

stale_data.why: latest Singapore reading is too old to describe 'now'
